_about: Pinterest pin queue. Marketing writes pins, security reviews them, Mark approves by merging. A daily GitHub Action (scripts/build-pin-feeds.mjs) adds each pin to its board's RSS feed on or after its publish date; Pinterest then posts it. Links must be thepartywheel.com URLs using only the pages' own preset parameters. No # share links, no shorteners.

holiday.title: The Party Wheel: Holiday party ideas

pins.title: Family Christmas Movie Night: Spin to Pick a Movie
pins.description: Can't agree on a family Christmas movie? Spin a free wheel of kid-friendly picks like Elf, Home Alone, Klaus, The Polar Express, and Arthur Christmas. No PG-13 or R picks, and each pick shows where to stream it. Free, no sign-up.
pins.alt: A spinning wheel of family Christmas movies with the headline Family Christmas Movie Night
pins.headline: Family Christmas Movie Night
pins.subhead: Kid-friendly picks only. Spin, then press play.

pins.title: White Elephant Gifts Under $10 (That Still Get Stolen)
pins.description: Small budget, big laughs. Spin for white elephant gift ideas under $10: fuzzy socks, hot cocoa, a pickle ornament, gross-flavor jelly beans, pocket card games, and more. Each idea links to shop it. Free, no sign-up.
pins.alt: A spinning wheel of cheap white elephant gift ideas with the headline White Elephant Gifts Under $10

pins.title: Classic Christmas Movies: Spin to Pick an Old Favorite
pins.description: Want an old-fashioned Christmas movie night? Spin a free wheel of 12 classics, from It’s a Wonderful Life and Miracle on 34th Street to White Christmas, A Christmas Story, and The Bishop’s Wife. Each pick shows a one-line summary plus where to stream, rent, or buy it. Free, no sign-up.

pins.headline: Classic Christmas Movie Night
pins.subhead: 12 old favorites. Spin, then press play.

pins.title: Funny White Elephant Gift Ideas: Spin for One
pins.description: Want the gift everyone fights over? Spin for funny white elephant ideas, from a rubber chicken and a prank gift box to a giant gummy bear and a singing fish. Pick a budget from under $10 to $50. Free, no sign-up.

pins.headline: Funny White Elephant Gifts

pins.title: Office Holiday Party Games for Big Groups: Spin for One
pins.description: Planning the office holiday party? Spin a free wheel of 11 holiday games for big groups (13+, play in teams), with no board games to buy: Charades, Fishbowl, Holiday Trivia, Two Truths and a Lie, Pass the Parcel, Holiday Pictionary, and more. Each spin shows quick rules. Free, no sign-up.

pins.headline: Office Party Games for Big Groups
pins.subhead: No board games to buy. Quick rules.

pins.title: White Elephant Gifts for a $25 Limit: Spin for One
pins.description: Office gift exchange with a $20 or $25 limit? Spin for practical white elephant ideas that usually cost $10 to $25: a sherpa throw blanket, an insulated tumbler, a portable phone charger, a mini waffle maker, a hot sauce sampler, and more. Prices vary, so check before you buy. Each idea links to shop it. Free, no sign-up.
